Source: codex/w5-docs lane, GitHub #784.

Proposal: surface GitHub issue state and a per-PR diff of new flags in `corvint changes`. UCL1142-V0-005 keeps NOT_OBSERVED until this exists.

title: `corvint changes`: GitHub issue state and per-PR new-flag diff (GitHub #784; UCL1142-V0-005 stays NOT_OBSERVED)
